title: My group chat added a new member last night. Everyone says they've known him for years.
transcript:
My group chat added a new member last night. Everyone says they've known him for years. The notification said Marcus was added to Friday Crew at 11:40 PM.

I didn't know a Marcus. I asked who he was. Dana replied right away. Lol, very funny. You hated him in college.

I scrolled up. He was in photos from my birthday. He was tagged in my own trip to the lake. In every picture he stood slightly behind someone, face half hidden, always smiling.

I called my brother. He said Marcus fixed his car last month and I owed him fifty dollars.

I checked my camera roll. Same pictures. Same smile. None of them had been there yesterday.

At 1 AM Marcus sent a message only to me. It said, you finally noticed. Give it a week and you won't.

I deleted the chat. It came back. I blocked his number. A new message arrived from my mother's phone: Marcus is coming to dinner Sunday, set an extra place.

I looked at my own photos one last time. In the newest one, taken this morning in my bathroom mirror, there are two of us.

He was holding my toothbrush.

I don't remember how long he's lived here.
